verdict.rationale: Sprinto exposes webhooks and custom integration/push APIs (Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, Integration Monitoring, webhook management) that could be scripted or invoked from CI pipelines for evidence ingestion, but there is no documented CLI, headless mode, or explicit CI/automation workflow example. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI-runnable command, explicit CI/CD pipeline integration guide, and independent confirmation of headless automation use.
